title: URGENT : DASH / Hit Stop injection but it did not stop
body:
I started a manual injection of 1.5U. Thinking that I had overdone my calculations, I hit _Stop/Cancel_ on the progression window at around 1U. I saw the red _Cancel has been pressed_ message (message might be a bit different, no screen capture)

The pump continued sending the insulin till the end of the 1.5U. The pump history and the treatments tab showed 1.5U injected.

If the user cannot cancel an ongoing bolus, it is an **urgent** bug. Imagine you type 15U instead of 1.5U and that you can't stop...

Logs at around 20:25

[AndroidAPS_LOG_1673378705327.log-1.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/10392438/AndroidAPS_LOG_1673378705327.log-1.zip)

comments.body: yes, pump was disconnected around 55% thus cancelation was not possible.  The risk is always there when pump doesn't have controls
